safety_keywords.description: Comma-separated words that re-ask the safety check on urgent fallen tree, flooding or streetlight reports (BRD FR-SAF-03). Matched at the start of words.

feature_offline_outbox.description: Phase 2 offline mode: reports made without a connection wait in an outbox and send later (FR-OFF).

feature_saved_places.description: Phase 2 saved places and nearby urgent alerts (FR-NTF-03, 04).

feature_society.description: Burghood society tab: find, join and run a society (Phase 1). Off shows a Coming soon screen.

feature_services.description: Burghood service requests and provider directory (Phase 3).

feature_monetisation.description: Burghood provider listing fees and sponsored listings (Phase 4).

service_categories.description: Service category groups and categories for Burghood services (Phase 3). JSON list of {id, label, approvalCheck, categories: [{id, label, synonyms}]}; synonyms map everyday words in a request to its category.

feature_google_places.description: Show Google Maps results in Services when no listed provider matches (Places API, billed per search). When off, a free link to Google Maps shows instead.
